title: Account for both native payloads in paired-plane identity blocks
body:
PR2126 gives a correct scalar identity using 56 rank-two matched-plane blocks, but leaves physical execution and application multiplicity open. This package implements those blocks through the inherited one-array native interface on all 56 actual selected planes. Each block needs two independent payloads: the resulting profile is `{7:224, 2:112}`, with copy mass 224 rather than the support-only screen's 112. Under the proposed two-unpaid-coordinate coverage law, even the favorable zero-saving moment is 293/292, so this direct implementation cannot improve kappa.

The contribution is the native implementation and source-bound occurrence audit of this specific missing interface. ctoth's team already reported the naive 224 baseline; Philippe Van Velzen's one-total model and 2-integral floor are credited. The per-pair argument here retains independently implemented blocks. It does not exclude shared fractional decoders, cross-plane mixing or a new multi-array primitive. No new kappa is claimed.

Validation passes on Linux CPython 3.12.3: registered assertion-disabled replay, 280 native recipes checked by the separate retained Gaussian interpreter including global phase, all 512 columns of one private descent, the dirty symbolic block, and eight rejecting controls. A one-payload positive control implements the rank-one broadcast correctly and is rejected as an identity. Source-only read-only export, changed-input/receipt rejection and output no-clobber checks also pass. Global hosting, backward orientation, all-size/precision/tape admission and the selected cold replay were not rerun. Hosted CI and independent human review remain separate.

Scientific base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. The final full overlap refresh covered 442 open PRs and 890 Discussion records, with complete pagination and no warnings; the exact PR2126 head was rechecked unchanged. Only `research/paired-plane-native-payload/` is added. Selected and frozen predecessor files are unchanged.

Credit Cinna Davis / PR1825 and PR2126, Adam Gall / PR1889, ctoth and collaborators, Philippe Van Velzen, Chafik Boukhalfa / PR1991, Ali Romman / PR1862, the retained compiler authors and the selected construction lineage. Prepared for Jeremy Diviney with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no sub-agents, independent human review or formal-kernel proof are claimed.
